text_block_list.text:
To celebrate New Year's, Фудзи Кисэки and
I go on
our first shrine visit of the year
together.
Have you decided what to pray for yet?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list:
I'm praying you have a lot of success in your
senior year, of course.

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what a coincidence! I'm going to
pray for
the same thing!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
We shuffle into line to wait for our turn
at the
shrine...
Hey, isn't that Фудзи Кисэки?!
text_block_list.name: Passerby A

text_block_list.text:
O-oh, wow! H-hello! I always watch your
races! I'm
looking forward to watching
this year too!
text_block_list.name: Passerby A

text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I get the feeling I'll have
great luck
this year after receiving such
sweet words of
support.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'll do my very best, so I hope you'll
continue
cheering me on!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: I-I will!
text_block_list.name: Passerby A

text_block_list.text: Holy crap, that's Фудзи Кисэки!
text_block_list.name: Passerby B

text_block_list.text:
No way, are you for real?! Wh-what
should we do?
Should we go say hi?!
text_block_list.name: Passerby C

text_block_list.text:
My, my, it's shaping up to be quite a
day.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
More and more people notice her, and
Fuji Kiseki
receives an endless stream of
well wishes.

Ahaha. It feels strange to have so many
people
calling out to me on New Year's
Day.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I suppose this is proof that I'm on
everyone's
radars now. Let's work hard
this year too, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Now that we're done with our shrine
visit, can I
talk to you about our plans
for today?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I know you've given me time off today
since it's
New Year's and all...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
But, after receiving so much support
from
everyone, I really want to run!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
What do you think? I'd like to train, but
only if
you're all right with it.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
As much as I want to respect her desire
to
practice, I'd like her to rest too...
choice_data_list: You should use today to rest up.
Let's sign you up for a New Year's marathon.
Let's do research on the races you plan to run!

text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're right. I guess I got a little
carried away.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
All right, then. My goal for today is to
rest to my
heart's content!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Hey, since we're out already, why don't
we see
what kind of New Year's deals
they have at the
shopping district?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Two red and white bean buns coming
right up!
Say, aren't you Фудзи Кисэки?
text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A

text_block_list.text: Oh, you know me?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Of course! Everyone does! You've been
working
so hard!
text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you'll do just fantastic this year
too!
Here, have an extra treat, on the
house!
text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A

text_block_list.text: Wow, thank you so much! I'll do my best!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
No matter where we go, it seems a lot of
people
have high hopes for Фудзи Кисэки.

A New Year's marathon, huh? That's a
great idea.
It'll be like I'm training even
though I'm still on
break!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Speaking of, I recall my sweet ponies
talking
excitedly about a marathon in
the shopping
district.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Let's see if it's still possible to sign up!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Thankfully, Фудзи Кисэки is able to register
for and
run in the shopping district's
marathon without a
hitch.
Huff, huff!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Aaah! She's really here! She's actually
running the
marathon!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Member A

text_block_list.text: You can do it, Fujiii!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Member B

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Thanks for cheering me on, my
ponies!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Fujiii! We love youuu!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Members

text_block_list.text:
No matter where we go, it seems a lot of
people
have high hopes for Фудзи Кисэки.
That's a great idea!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The steep hill at the end of the final
stretch will
be killer. I'll have to be
careful to reserve enough
energy for it.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Let's see, these files are about last year's

Takamatsunomiya Kinen...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, my vision's blurry. I think I overdid
it with my
research...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
No matter where we go, it seems a lot of
people
have high hopes for Фудзи Кисэки.

The challenges we'll be facing this year
will be
difficult, but thanks to everyone's
support, she's
fired up and ready for
anything!
